name: Shizuku
message: 「...There, all set.」
I make the final adjustments to my Origami―Type 13, No. 9: Shadow―ahead of the next match.
In the workshop, Technical Division students bustle back and forth.
The smell of scorched metal and the whine of grinders—I loved this atmosphere.

name: Shizuku
message: （Sigh... The main tournament is finally here...）
I've never really liked standing out in the first place.
Being able to lose myself alone in the things I love was always the best time for me.
Yes, if not for that encounter—I should have been completely content on my own.
...My parents were history researchers.
They were often away from home on fieldwork, leaving me by myself most of the time.
I never really felt lonely. In fact, being alone actually put me at ease.
Because my parents were very temperamental and always irritated about something.
Figuring out how not to ruin their mood—that was my biggest mission as a child.
—So I was thrilled when I got into Murakumo Academy.
A full boarding school with completely private rooms—this environment was heaven to me.

name: Teacher
message: 「...Minamoto Shizuku, why are you in the Technical Division？」

name: Teacher
message: 「Your strikes, your reads, even your spiritual sensitivity are all outstanding！ You really should transfer to the Martial Arts Division, even now.」

First- and second-year students take the same classes regardless of whether they're in the Martial Arts Division, Technical Division, or Quartermaster Division. So I participated in sparring practice during class too.
Before I knew it, my swordsmanship somehow caught their eye.

name: Shizuku
message: 「Um... I'm more interested in spiritual mechanisms and how Tenju works than in fighting... so the Technical Division suits me better...」

name: Teacher
message: 「I see... Still, it'd be a waste not to put that talent to use! All right, why don't you try entering the Martial Festival preliminaries?!」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Wh-What, um, I couldn't...」
In the end, I couldn't bring myself to refuse and wound up entering the Martial Festival preliminaries.
...I was eliminated in the preliminaries that year, but I placed 11th. For a first-year, it was by no means a bad result.
Because of that, I ended up getting selected for the Martial Festival preliminaries again in my second year.

name: Teacher
message: 「Whoa, that's incredible！ You made it to the main tournament！」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Um, thank you very much...」
Once I realized how much useful data I could gather from fighting strong opponents, I got carried away.
Looking back now, I really should have held back more.

name: Shizuku
message: 「Ugh... How did things turn out like this...」
At the Martial Festival main tournament, right there—I met her.

name: Victoria
message: 「Hiii！ Minamoto Shizuku？ So you're a second-year too. Let's enjoy our match together！！」
To put it mildly, her fighting style was quite amateurish.
Her offensive technique was so inconsistent that my first impression was... how on earth did she win her way up to the main tournament like this?
But her spirit sensitivity was incredible, and the way she believed in herself and charged straight at me was dazzling.
She wielded her Origami and performed Jindou as if she were having the time of her life. She truly loved Jindou from the bottom of her heart.

name: Shizuku
message: （Yeah, I think I'll end it here...）
It felt wrong for someone like me, who wasn't even giving it my all, to defeat someone who felt that way.
So, I held back a little and conceded the victory to Victoria.
That was how my second-year Martial Festival ended. As far as I was concerned, it was a satisfying curtain call.
...But there were some who didn't see it that way.

name: Victoria
message: 「Hey, hey！！ Is Minamoto Shizuku here！？」

name: Shizuku
message: 「...Victoria？」

name: Victoria
message: 「What was that match earlier？ Why did you get so weak halfway through！？」

name: Victoria
message: 「I can tell！ You held back, didn't you！！」

name: Victoria
message: 「That's not okay, why would you do that？ Why！？」

name: Shizuku
message: 「U-um... I'm so sorry...」
Confronted like that, I had no choice but to apologize.
I explained the situation to her while she sulked. She seemed surprised when she found out I was from the Technical Division.

name: Victoria
message: 「Whaaaat！？ Shizu, you're from the Technical Division？ And you're still that strong？ That's amazing！！」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Um, I'm really sorry... for doing something that sullied your match...」

name: Victoria
message: 「It's fine, it's fine! Now I know that Shizu had her own reasons for it!」

name: Victoria
message: 「More importantly, Shizu, how was it, fighting me？ Did I look cool？ Tell me what you thought！」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Um, are you sure you want me to be honest...？」

name: Victoria
message: 「Of course！ Otherwise, there's no point！」

name: Shizuku
message: 「...I thought you weren't very strong.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Whoaaaaaah！？ Really！？ Wh-where？ What was wrong with it！？」
I listed every issue I had noticed during our match and told them to her.

name: Victoria
message: 「Whoa！ Yeah, you might be right！」

name: Victoria
message: 「Shizu, you're amazing！ You can tell all that just from fighting me once！」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Also, the settings for your Origami don't suit you right now. Would you mind letting me have a look at your Origami？」

name: Victoria
message: 「Yaaay！ Look at all of it you want！」
I borrowed the Origami and was stunned.
Victoria's Origami was still using almost entirely factory-default settings.

name: Shizuku
message: 「……You, could it be that you've never had a fitting done before？」

name: Victoria
message: 「What？ What's a 'fitting'？」
Victoria's reply made my head spin. I was, conversely, impressed that she’d managed to fight at all like this.
And just like that, something sparked inside me.
If this girl went into battle with the perfect setup, what kind of fight would she show me, I wondered.

name: Shizuku
message: 「……Hey, Victoria.」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Um…… if you’re okay with it, I’d like to be your Second……」
The data I could gain through her would surely be fascinating. Once I thought that and made the offer—

name: Victoria
message: 「Really！？ Yay, do it, do it！ Please, teach me！！」
She readily agreed.

name: Umpire
message: 「Match over！！！」
……And just like that, she won the Martial Festival spectacularly.

name: Victoria
message: 「Shizu, Shizu！！ You did it, did you see！？ I won, I actually became a Toujinegi！」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Yes, I saw. Congratulations, Vicky……！！」
With an Origami fully customized to match her, Vicky's real ability had swelled many times over.

name: Victoria
message: 「Thank you, Shizu, it’s all thanks to you!! I love you, Shizu, Lovin’ you～～～!」

name: Shizuku
message: 「Wait, Vicky…… mmm, nnh……！」
I had my kiss stolen by an excited Vicky.
……But, for some reason, I was happy about that too.
Before I knew it, Vicky had transformed into an irreplaceable existence for me――.
Match time was approaching, and I headed to the entrance.
Exactly one year had passed since that time we experienced the Martial Festival victory together with Vicky.
I'm a third-year now, and this is my last year participating in the Martial Festival. I wonder what I'll be doing this time next year.

name: Shizuku
message: 「……Vicky.」
Until a little while ago, I had somehow thought I'd probably be in the pro team Vicky was starting up.
But now――

name: Momiji
message: 「Independence and self-reliance. To forgo the use of a Second, and handle everything from forging the blade to adjusting the Origami entirely on one's own.」

name: Momiji
message: 「That is the path of a fencer who aims to be self-sufficient.」

name: Victoria
message: 「Whoaaa…！ What is that, ama-zing！ It’s super cool, like one of those lone swordsmen！？」

name: Momiji
message: 「Well, if you want to put it coolly, I suppose that’s what it is…」

name: Victoria
message: 「I see~! So you’re aiming to be a perfect man who relies on no one and handles everything all by himself!」

name: Victoria
message: 「That’s great~! It’s so like Okita-kun! Maybe I should try doing that too~」

name: Victoria
message: 「I’ve been leaving all the little things up to Shizuku until now, but that’s no good, it’s not cool at all」

name: Victoria
message: 「From now on, I’ll even make and prepare my own Origami！」
Suzakuin-san was right.
If one were a true swordsman, it would be problematic if they couldn't fit things to their own condition themselves.
If she doesn't learn to do for herself what she should be doing, it's Vicky herself who will be in trouble later.

name: Shizuku
message: 「But if that happens, I’ll… be unnecessary.」
That, and only that—was something I absolutely could not allow.
